geometry_node.node.set_light_shadow.comm: Changes shadow enablement and source size for soft shadows. Other properties are preserved.
geometry_node.node.set_light_volume.comm: Changes volume mode and parameters. Uniform uses constant density; Noise adds moving density variation. Off preserves surface lighting.

geometry_node.node.set_light_quality.com: Changes this light's shadow samples 1..16 and ratio 0.1..1, volume steps 4..64 and ratio 0.1..1. Other lights are unaffected.
geometry_node.node.set_light_lifecycle.c: Enabled immediately controls emission, not a delayed switch. Executing this node restarts the timer; expiry removes the light, and 0 means unlimited. Disabling does not pause the timer. Other setters preserve expiry.

geometry_node.light.port_help.shadow_ena: Enables occlusion and soft shadows. When disabled, lighting passes through occluders.
geometry_node.light.port_help.area_width: Rectangular emitter width along its local X axis, 0.01..8 blocks, default 1. Emits only toward local +Z. Dimensions affect illumination and soft shadows; brightness retains the same total strength.
geometry_node.light.port_help.area_heigh: Rectangular emitter height along its local Y axis, 0.01..8 blocks, default 1. Independent of radius. Uses the existing surface and volume emitter sample settings.
geometry_node.light.port_help.flow_out: Continues execution after the operation; does not indicate success.
geometry_node.light.port_help.resource_i: Light resource ID for setters or removal; creation failure returns an empty ID.
geometry_node.light.port_help.key: Resource ID: empty generates a new unique ID on each execution; a name resolves in the current graph scope; a complete ID addresses that light. Reusing an ID replaces its light. Creation outputs the resolved ID.
geometry_node.light.port_help.type: Point sources illuminate all directions; spot sources illuminate a cone; rectangular area sources emit from their entire front face toward local +Z. Rotation (90,0,0) faces down.
geometry_node.light.port_help.color: Light RGB color; each component is 0..1.
geometry_node.light.port_help.config: Legacy light configuration; new graphs use Set Light actions.
geometry_node.light.port_help.base: Base configuration; only this setting group is replaced.
geometry_node.light.port_help.position: Position in blocks: world coordinates when unbound, entity-local coordinates when bound.
geometry_node.light.port_help.rotation: Euler rotation in degrees: X pitch, Y yaw, Z roll. Relative to the entity when bound.
geometry_node.light.port_help.source_vis: Shows the emitting surface: a sphere for point sources, a disk for spot sources, or a front-facing rectangle for area sources. Uses the light's color, brightness, dimensions and orientation.
geometry_node.light.port_help.edge_softn: Cone edge transition, 0..1; zero is a hard edge.
geometry_node.light.port_help.entity: Optional anchor entity in this dimension; follows its interpolated position and orientation.
geometry_node.light.port_help.local_offs: Additional offset in blocks relative to the light's base rotation.
geometry_node.light.port_help.local_rota: Additional local Euler rotation in degrees.
geometry_node.light.port_help.follow_vie: Follows head yaw and pitch when enabled; otherwise follows body yaw.
geometry_node.light.port_help.eye_anchor: Uses the entity's eye position; otherwise uses its base position.
geometry_node.light.port_help.enabled: Immediately enables this group: occlusion in Shadow, emission in Lifecycle. Disabling emission retains the resource but does not pause expiry. This is not a delayed switch.
geometry_node.light.port_help.source_siz: Emitter radius, 0..4 blocks. Point sources use a sphere; spot sources use a disk. Affects illumination, soft shadows, volume and the visible surface. Zero uses a central point and hides the surface.
geometry_node.light.port_help.mode: Off disables volume; Uniform uses constant density; Noise adds moving density variation.
geometry_node.light.port_help.strength: Volume brightness multiplier, 0..100; surface lighting is unaffected.
geometry_node.light.port_help.noise_stre: Density variation strength, 0..1; Noise mode only.
geometry_node.light.port_help.noise_scal: Noise spatial scale, 0.001..1024 blocks; Noise mode only.
geometry_node.light.port_help.velocity: Noise movement velocity in blocks per second; Noise mode only.
geometry_node.light.port_help.seed: Signed integer noise seed; equal seeds produce equal patterns.
geometry_node.light.port_help.path: Projection image path. Empty disables it; remote:/ reads a server image, resource: a resource image, otherwise a client-local file.
geometry_node.light.port_help.colored: Uses image RGB when enabled, luminance otherwise; both use alpha.
geometry_node.light.port_help.shadow_res: Surface lighting buffer width and height ratio, 0.1..1, default 1. Includes illumination and local shadows, not volume lighting. A ratio of 0.5 evaluates about one quarter of the pixels.
geometry_node.light.port_help.shadow_sam: Emitter samples for surface illumination and soft shadows, integer 4..16, default 4; independent of volume lighting. Zero radius uses 1. Disabling shadows retains lighting samples. The legacy combined quality node still sets both paths.
geometry_node.light.port_help.volume_sam: Volume depth quality, integer 4..64, default 24. The grid uses twice this value in depth slices, with a minimum of 32 and maximum of 128: 6 gives 32 slices and 24 gives 48. Higher values preserve more lighting variation along the view ray at greater computation and memory cost. Does not change surface lighting samples.
geometry_node.light.port_help.volume_res: Per-light volume grid spatial quality, 0.1..1, default 0.5. Grid width and height are the screen dimensions multiplied by this value and divided by 4, rounded up. A value of 1 gives one cell per 4x4 screen pixels; 0.5 gives one per 8x8. Lower values improve speed but reduce beam edge detail. Does not change surface lighting resolution.
geometry_node.light.port_help.duration_t: Lifetime in server ticks, 0..2147483647; zero is unlimited. Setting lifetime restarts its timer.
geometry_node.node.set_light_surface_qua: Changes surface quality without changing volume quality or light appearance settings.
geometry_node.node.set_light_volume_qual: Changes volume quality without changing surface quality, density, noise or enabled state.
geometry_node.light.port_help.volume_emi: Emitter samples per volume grid cell, integer 4..16, default 4; independent of surface lighting. Zero radius uses 1. Higher values improve finite-emitter occlusion at greater lighting computation cost.

geometry_node.node.behavior_get_blackboa: Reads the current value of a key in the selected scope. A missing key returns null and never falls back to the same key in another scope.

geometry_node.node.behavior_clear_blackb: Removes the entire key and value from the selected scope. Clearing a missing key is a successful no-op.
geometry_node.node.behavior_blackboard_v: Succeeds when the key's revision in the selected scope has changed since this node last observed it. The first observation only establishes a baseline.
geometry_node.node.behavior_blackboard.c: Blackboard storage is dynamic: nodes use only scope and key (plus value for Set). Assets do not declare schemas, defaults, write permissions, or scope IDs; same-named keys never fall back across scopes.
INSTANCE: belongs only to the current behavior-tree instance; released when it ends and never persisted.
OWNER: belongs to the current entity UUID; shared by that entity's tree instances and saved with the entity.
SHARED: one server-wide persistent map shared by all entities and assets. Authors manage key naming themselves.
GROUP: belongs to the current scoreboard team; shared by team members and persisted. It is unavailable when the entity has no team.
WORLD: belongs to the entity's current dimension; shared within a dimension, isolated across dimensions, and persisted.
geometry_node.node.behavior_move_to.comm: Navigates continuously until the owner's three-dimensional distance to the target is within Arrival Distance. It fails if navigation ends early, the target becomes invalid, or progress can no longer continue. A complete failure to create the initial path produces an execution error.

Position mode uses absolute world coordinates. Ground mobs plan through traversable blocks; an enclosed target may produce a partial path to the closest reachable position and then fail. An airborne target normally resolves to nearby ground or no path for ground mobs, while flying mobs may reach it directly.

Entity mode retains the target entity and resubmits navigation to its current position every 10 ticks. It succeeds within Arrival Distance and fails if the target dies, is removed, changes dimension, or navigation ends before arrival. A temporarily unreachable moving target may be approached along a partial path before replanning fails.

If the route becomes blocked while moving, vanilla navigation attempts to continue or adjust. Continued lack of progress triggers stuck detection or waypoint timeout, stops navigation, and makes this node fail.

Pathfinding debug: blue is the requested position, green is the actual planned endpoint, yellow is the next waypoint, and the cyan line is the remaining path. Separate blue and green markers mean the current plan cannot reach the requested position.

The node leases movement to block ordinary MOVE goals. Mobs driven by the Brain behavior system, such as villagers, may still overwrite vanilla Navigation, causing a temporary detour before tracking resumes.
geometry_node.node.behavior_follow.comme: Continuously follows the entity fixed when this node starts. Reaching Minimum Distance stops navigation but keeps the node Running so movement resumes if the target moves away.
The target is retained while its three-dimensional distance is at most Maximum Distance. Exceeding it ends Follow with OUT_OF_RANGE. Maximum Distance must not be less than Minimum Distance.
Pathfinding debug draws a magenta line between the follower and its current Follow target. The line remains while waiting inside Minimum Distance and is removed as soon as Follow exits.
geometry_node.node.behavior_patrol.comme: Navigates through the coordinate list in stable order. Non-looping patrol succeeds after the last waypoint; looping patrol returns to the first waypoint and remains Running. The waypoint list is frozen when the node enters.

Exact mode requires the vanilla path to reach the requested waypoint and advances when the owner enters Arrival Distance. Exact constrains the destination; it does not force geometrically straight movement.
Region mode treats each waypoint as an area center. The planned endpoint and final owner position may be anywhere inside Patrol Radius; vanilla pathfinding still detours around obstacles.
After each arrival, waits for a random duration in the inclusive Minimum-to-Maximum Wait Tick range. Equal values produce a fixed wait; zero to zero disables waiting.

The node leases only movement. Invalid routes, unavailable paths, or paths ending early fail. Stop, suspend, or preemption immediately stops navigation and clears the pathfinding debug target. Re-entry starts from the first waypoint.
geometry_node.node.behavior_attack_targe: Assigns a living entity as the owner's attack target and then completes immediately; target-selection ownership remains until cleared, invalidated, or the tree ends.
The target must be within the target assignment range when this node runs. This value does not change the owner's melee, ranged, or skill range.

After assignment, native AI cannot select another target, but the owner's native or custom AI still decides how to pursue and attack. This node does not navigate, deal damage, choose skills, or control attack cooldowns.
